tier_reason: link 1 could write a wrong local grade or streak increment and link 3 could crash result polling on every poll while a game was live; neither firing is evidenced for a specific date

contract.text: A double-down day is graded only when both legs' games are final: hit only if both batters hit, and a hit advances the streak by two.
contract.source: 1d9c199 body; src/bts/picks.py reconcile_results streak walk (+2 for a double-down hit) at 0ba01e1

mechanism.text: run_result_polling watched only the primary's game; when it went final first, check_hit on the still-running double-down game returned None and was dropped, so the day was graded from the primary alone (+1 on a primary hit, and a 'hit' before the second leg was known)
reconcile_results recomputed the streak only when it found a result correction, so a wrong increment on an unchanged result was never repaired
1d9c199 renamed status to statuses but the suspended check still read status, so every poll with a game not yet final raised NameError in run_result_polling

watchdog.trigger: a date's result is recorded while any leg's game is not final, or streak.json differs from the forward replay of graded pick files (+2 for a double-down hit)
watchdog.recovery_assertion: each double-down date is graded from both legs after both games are final, and streak.json equals the replay

evidence.what: polling watched only the primary's game; if check_hit on the second game returned None the result list had one element, 'so streak incremented by 1 instead of 2'; reconciliation now always recalculates from scratch — no date is named
the variable was renamed from status to statuses, but the suspended check still used the old name
on 4/06 the dashboard showed a double pick with one game Final and one Live (a cross-game double with staggered finishes)

at 0ba01e1 a None second leg was skipped (if double_result is not None); at 3e0f11b 'if status == "suspended"' is reached on every iteration where not all games are final, and status is undefined there
